hook: Homeplus hit a bankruptcy crisis when daily sales plunged to 3 billion won.

sections.voiceover: Homeplus hit a bankruptcy crisis when daily sales plunged to 3 billion won.
b_roll: Store facade of Homeplus in South Korea

sections.voiceover: Reopening day brought 10.6 billion won in sales on August 13, 2026. Where did the remaining 70 percent go?
b_roll: Empty aisles at a Homeplus hypermarket

sections.voiceover: Worse, plunging daily sales during the early-October holiday period now threaten those 200 billion won DIP funds.
Management plans to sell 19 of 37 company-owned stores by February 2028. New collateralized loans total 592 billion won.
Additional financing seeks 1.5 trillion won before February 2028.
